alpha_source.name: M6_Ensemble
alpha_source.description: Equal-weighted rank-average ensemble of 5 ML models (M1 Ridge, M2 LASSO, M3 ElasticNet, M4 XGB-GPU, M5 LGB) cross-section ranking on 1,047 features per sig_date.

factor_specs.ensemble_method: rank-average across 5 models per sig_date (each component cross-section rank-normalized 0-1, equal-weighted average).
factor_specs.feature_pool: 1,047 features = 288 monthly factor_db + 7 layers (a/b/c/d/e/f/g/h/i) per WT-D20260514_008 build_features_pool.R
factor_specs.training_protocol: 7 folds expanding window. train 60mo + val 12mo per fold. lockbox = last 2 folds (24mo OOS).
factor_specs.mechanism_text: ML ensemble cross-section ranking via 1,047-feature monthly panel. Each ML head (Ridge L2 linear / LASSO L1 sparse / EN convex blend / XGB-GPU tree boosting / LGB gradient boosting) provides orthogonal inductive bias. Rank-average ensemble reduces single-model variance and model-selection bias (Kelly-Malamud-Zhou 2024 RFS — ML for empirical asset pricing). Cross-sectional rank normalization within sig_date ensures monotone alpha-vector irrespective of market-level regime (PIT C13 compatible — no sign flip, alignment-preserving). Sample bias correction: longer 84m sample (60 is + 24 lockbox 2019-01~2025-12) replaces ABORTED WT_013 60m subsample where bi-monthly variant SR 2.267 was spurious; sample-stable monthly variant retain.
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Per Charter §13 Research Philosophy v1.0 Trend P1 (Factor Zoo 축소): ML ensemble is validation-first (not discovery-first), reducing alpha to single rank-aggregated cross-section signal from 1,047 raw features. Redundancy compression via rank averaging suppresses Trefler-Kelly-Malamud 'Factor Zoo proliferation' bias. Underlying economic mechanism: priced-factor exposures (value/quality/momentum/profitability/low-vol/skewness/macro-beta) embedded in 1,047 features → ML cross-section learning extracts non-linear interactions + dummies + lags that single-factor approaches miss. Production-safe: rank-normalize per sig_date ⇒ no level information leakage; lockbox-isolated ⇒ no future look. Kelly-Malamud-Pedersen 2022 JFE cost-aware extension via M7_XGB_CostAware retain as Phase 1.B candidate.
factor_specs.redundancy_cluster_id: CLUSTER_ML_ENSEMBLE_v1 (single ML head — STR_1715 family is non-ML residual flow + AR cross-section + R05 tail-risk overlay, 직교).
